name: 7-methyl-α-ethyltryptamine
summary: 7-Methyl-α-ethyltryptamine (7-Me-αET) is a tryptamine derivative related to α-ethyltryptamine (αET). It was discovered by a team at Upjohn in the early 1960s.

pharmacology.text: It has similar pharmacological effects to αET, but is both 3-4 times more potent as a serotonin releasing agent, and 10 times more potent as a monoamine oxidase inhibitor, making it potentially hazardous as this pharmacological profile is shared with drugs such as PMA and 4-MTA, which are known to be dangerous in humans when used at high doses.

uses.text: It has similar pharmacological effects to αET, but is both 3-4 times more potent as a serotonin releasing agent, and 10 times more potent as a monoamine oxidase inhibitor, making it potentially hazardous as this pharmacological profile is shared with drugs such as PMA and 4-MTA, which are known to be dangerous in humans when used at high doses.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. It is both a stronger serotonin releaser and a much stronger blocker of monoamine oxidase than αET. That combination is hazardous, because it can cause serotonin syndrome and dangerous rises in blood pressure.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它釋放血清素的能力比αET強，抑制單胺氧化酶的能力更是強得多。這樣的組合很危險，因為可能引起血清素症候群與血壓危險升高。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它释放血清素的能力比αET强，抑制单胺氧化酶的能力更是强得多。这样的组合很危险，因为可能引起血清素症候群与血压危险升高。

fact.en: A team at Upjohn discovered it in the early 1960s, in the same programme that produced αET, which the company briefly sold as the antidepressant Monase.
fact.zh: Upjohn公司的團隊在1960年代初期發現了它，而同一個研究計畫也產生了αET，該公司曾短暫以抗憂鬱藥「Monase」的名稱販售αET。
fact.zhHans: Upjohn公司的团队在1960年代初期发现了它，而同一个研究计划也产生了αET，该公司曾短暂以抗忧郁药「Monase」的名称贩售αET。
